story: Alex sat on the edge of the porch steps, the late afternoon sun warm on his arms. He watched the shadows lengthen across the lawn, listening to birds call from the maple tree. His breathing was steady, matching the gentle rhythm of the breeze. A cup of tea rested on the railing, steam curling upward. He took a slow sip, feeling the heat spread through him. A soft smile touched his lips as a cat wandered into the patch of sunlight nearby. He let his thoughts drift, content to watch and listen, as if time itself had slowed just enough for him to simply be.

Alex sat on the porch steps, the wooden surface cool beneath his palms. He watched a sparrow land nearby, tilting its head as it pecked at crumbs. The afternoon sun slanted through the leaves, dappling his knees with shifting light. He took a slow breath, letting the scents of cut grass and earth fill his lungs. The distant sound of a lawnmower faded into the background, replaced by the rhythmic chirping of insects. Alex let his fingers trail gently along the railing, savoring the solidness of the wood beneath his touch. For a while, he simply watched, listened, and let the moment unfold.

Alex sat on the porch steps, the morning air cool against his skin. He watched a sparrow hop along the rail, wings flickering. His breathing slowed to match the gentle sway of the trees. The distant sound of a lawnmower faded, replaced by the soft tick of a clock inside. Alex lifted a cup of tea to his lips, letting its warmth seep into his hands. He let his gaze drift, noticing how shadows stretched across the grass. For a few minutes, he did nothing but exist, the world around him moving at a pace that matched the rhythm of his own heart.
